name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – After § 10 – Am 77
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 10a. Rejects any increase in administrative expenditures resulting from the establishment and management of the support loan to Ukraine; considers that these tasks should be carried out within the framework of existing administrative resources; calls on the Commission to identify all possible savings, streamline administrative expenditures, and ensure rigorous and responsible management of Union funds, without imposing additional burdens on the Union budget;
